description: This file defines the PaymentModule interface, which specifies methods for payment processing operations such as transaction initiation, authorization, capture, and refund within a payment integration context.

classes.name: PaymentModule
classes.description: An interface defining payment processing operations such as transaction validation, initialization, authorization, capture, refund, etc.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the payment module configuration using the provided integration configuration and merchant store.

methods.name: initTransaction
methods.description: Initializes a payment transaction, returning a Transaction object for the provided customer, store, amount, payment, configuration, and module.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Authorizes a payment for a list of shopping cart items, returning a Transaction object.

methods.name: capture
methods.description: Captures a previously authorized transaction associated with an order.

methods.name: authorizeAndCapture
methods.description: Performs authorization and capture in a single step for the specified items and amount.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Processes a refund, either partial or full, for a given transaction and order.
